analysis_type: Post-hoc mechanism diagnosis after the grouped stress test; not preregistered and not independent validation
scientific_question: Which measurable local-identifiability and extrapolation diagnostics accompany Hahn1 fold 1 failure, and how do they differ from folds 2-5 without refitting or changing the model?

model.parameters: Reuse the exact seven parameters recorded for each grouped-stress fold

diagnostics.training_jacobian: Analytic derivatives at each fold's frozen training fit: derivatives of b1-b4 are x^(i-1)/D; derivatives of b5-b7 are -prediction*x^(i-4)/D
diagnostics.column_scaling: Divide each Jacobian column by its Euclidean norm before singular-value analysis; report raw and scaled singular values separately
diagnostics.numerical_rank_rule: Singular values greater than max(matrix shape)*machine_epsilon*largest_singular_value; numerical rank is not equated with global structural identifiability
diagnostics.local_linearized_covariance: sigma2 = training residual sum of squares/(n-7); use the column-scaled Jacobian pseudo-inverse with rcond=1e-12, then transform back to parameter units
diagnostics.parameter_correlation: Covariance divided by products of local linearized standard errors; inspect rather than threshold retrospectively
diagnostics.prediction_sensitivity: Local delta-method prediction standard deviation on every held-out point from the training Jacobian and training residual variance; this is a local sensitivity diagnostic, not a calibrated prediction interval
diagnostics.denominator: Minimum absolute denominator on fitting and held-out observations, reported separately from conditioning and prediction error
diagnostics.controls: Report all five folds; compare fold 1 with folds 2-5 without deleting failures or selecting a more favorable split

prohibitions: No refitting, model changes, added parameters, retuned starts or new slice selection
No claim that a high condition number alone proves global non-identifiability
No claim that full numerical rank proves physically meaningful or globally identifiable parameters
No interpretation of delta-method sensitivity as a calibrated uncertainty interval or independent experimental error
No use of post-hoc explanation to reverse or conceal the fold 1 failure
